positions.title: Thesis Student/Research - Efficient Acceleration of the AES algorithm in Graphics Hardware
positions.description: For a backup application where the encryption algorithms are intensive computational activities; I investigated the challenges and feasibility of parallelizing the AES algorithm by using GPUs. I explored the benefits of using these accelerators and potential issues when using them for general purpose computation. In doing so, I have implemented my solution using the CUDA architecture provided by NVidia achieving excellent results, and obtaining a final grade of 1.0.
